Here's the `.fd` source for this figure. A few authoring notes first:

- Three nodes (`probe`, `normalizer`, `sink`) with short labels — the roles ("emits raw samples," "reshapes," "writes to storage") belong in your surrounding prose, not crammed into the node labels.
- Two edges, `probe → normalizer` and `normalizer → sink`.
- The jog around the future third element is **pure rendering geometry** — it doesn't change what the edge means, so it belongs in the `layout` zone via `pin`, not as a semantic edge attribute. I gave the first edge an id (`e1`) so the `pin` line has something to address.
- I did not load `reference/scene.md` / `reference/layout.md` in this session, so treat the exact `pin ... via=` spelling as my best-effort reconstruction from the core grammar rules (bare point syntax, layout-zone-only-carries-`pin`) — run it through `build-svg.js` and let a `Line N:` error correct the spelling if it's off, rather than trusting this blind.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block

title "Alert-forwarding chain"

block probe "Probe"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block sink "Sink"

edge e1 probe -> normalizer
edge e2 normalizer -> sink

layout
pin e1 via=(60,20),(90,40)   # reserves a jog for a future element that will
                              # sit between probe and normalizer; geometry
                              # only, no meaning implied by the route
```

